title: Organization (offices, hub, administrators)
description: Read-only checks of the redesigned Organization screens (docs/plans/organization-ux-redesign-plan.md): the office registry's status tabs, filters and next step for an area ICT officer; the office hub's readiness, roles, staff, activity and the Pause dialog guard (never submitted); Add office's find-first step and server validation (nothing created); a local administrator's My office; role and area boundaries; and the national Administrators and directory screens (needs a super user, so it is blocked on the seeded dataset). Counts and statuses are compared with the database. Run after any change to packages/gov-store/organization or the theming workflow kit.
